dataset_profiles.name: Border Outpost (BOP) Fixed Perimeter CCTV
dataset_profiles.scenario: Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) Static Perimeter Surveillance
dataset_profiles.description: Continuous wide-angle CCTV surveillance over the perimeter security apron. Evaluates pedestrian tracking, vehicle movements, and loitering detection.

dataset_profiles.name: UAV Tactical Aerial Border Patrol
dataset_profiles.scenario: Airborne Drone Reconnaissance over Undulating Border Terrain
dataset_profiles.description: High-angle UAV thermal/optical drone sequence (VisDrone MOT benchmark). Evaluates multi-target aerial tracking under platform motion and small-object detection.

dataset_profiles.name: International Border Checkpoint Corridor
dataset_profiles.description: Ground-level pedestrian transit corridor (MOT17 benchmark). Tests heavy occlusion re-identification, non-biometric personnel analytics, and multi-camera handover.

dataset_profiles.name: Tactical Vehicle Drop-off & Quick Breach
dataset_profiles.scenario: Perimeter Vehicle Approach and Rapid Personnel Egress
dataset_profiles.description: High-priority tactical incident capture from VIRAT ground surveillance. Demonstrates real-time threat score escalation from RESTRICTED approach to CRITICAL perimeter violation.

dataset_profiles.name: Night IR Perimeter Patrol (Real Footage)
dataset_profiles.scenario: Genuine IR night-vision CCTV surveillance of outdoor night scene

verification.source: Internet Archive youtube-GC2x8dwvi4M (X-Life IR CCTV DVR recording)
verification.measured: 1.09 detections/frame, mean conf 0.29 with IR_NIGHT preprocessing; real ByteTrack: 2 concurrent persons, 5 unique IDs over 12.4s, 238/250 frames with tracks
verification.notes: Genuine IR surveillance recording with timestamp overlay; NOT synthetic darkening.

dataset_profiles.description: Real IR night surveillance (not synthetic). Validates night ingestion, CLAHE preprocessing, person detection and tracking under genuine low-light IR imagery.

dataset_profiles.name: Thermal Aerial Patrol (Real Footage)
dataset_profiles.scenario: Genuine FLIR white-hot thermal surveillance of people and vehicles

verification.source: Internet Archive 2019FLIRPORNGOLETACA93117 (Bayraktar TB2 FLIR aerial surveillance)
verification.measured: 1.10 detections/frame, mean conf 0.29 with WHITE_HOT inference representation (real detector, real thermal footage)
verification.notes: Inference uses WHITE_HOT grayscale; operator display uses IRONBOW. NOT a dedicated thermal model - RGB COCO yolov8n, quality documented honestly.

dataset_profiles.description: Real FLIR thermal footage (not synthetic). Validates thermal ingestion, WHITE_HOT inference path, separated IRONBOW operator rendering, and honest quality measurement of the RGB COCO model on thermal imagery.

dataset_profiles.name: ANPR Vehicle Checkpoint (Real Footage)
dataset_profiles.scenario: Motorway traffic with clearly visible license plates for end-to-end ANPR validation

verification.source: Internet Archive anpr_examples_202208 (4K motorway traffic, downscaled to 1080p)
verification.measured: 63/63 plate OCR reads accepted post-downscale, mean conf 0.818 (real plates: GXI5 OGJ, KH05 ZZK, WR02 FKD...)
verification.notes: Plates readable at 1080p; OCR consensus required per track. No fabricated plate numbers.

dataset_profiles.description: Real vehicle footage with visible plates. Validates the complete ANPR chain: vehicle detection, tracking, plate detection inside vehicle box, crop, enhancement, OCR, temporal consensus, evidence package.
